jurisdiction.name: Viet Nam
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Viet Nam moved from its 2021 national AI strategy to a full risk-based Law on Artificial Intelligence (Law 134/2025/QH15), in force since 1 March 2026, with an implementing decree in force from May 2026, which replaced the AI chapter of the 2025 Law on the Digital Technology Industry. A National AI Ethics Framework adopted by the Ministry of Science and Technology in March 2026 binds public-sector AI, the 2025 Personal Data Protection Law and its implementing decree set rules on AI and automated processing, and a new National AI Strategy to 2030 with a vision to 2045 was adopted in August 2026 alongside a national programme for AI human resources and AI education rules for schools.
narrative.review_notes: This review was completed on 12 October 2026 and covers national law, government, ministries and regulators. Not yet verified from the official text: the content of two located records whose official texts are image-only or published on the education ministry's site.

instruments.official_title: Luật Trí tuệ nhân tạo (Luật số 134/2025/QH15)
instruments.summary: Viet Nam's framework AI law (8 chapters, 35 articles) adopted on 10 December 2025. It classifies AI systems as high, medium or low risk (art. 9), requires notification and classification, conformity assessment and management of high-risk systems, incident handling, and transparency duties: users must know when they interact with AI, AI-generated audio/images/video must carry machine-readable marks, and deepfakes simulating real people or events must be clearly labelled (art. 11). It also sets prohibited acts, a national AI ethics framework and impact assessment (arts. 26-27), a controlled-testing mechanism, a National AI Development Fund, and makes the Ministry of Science and Technology the focal state management agency (art. 30).
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Primary horizontal AI law; repeals the AI chapter of the Law on Digital Technology Industry.
instruments.current_status: In force since 1 March 2026 (art. 34). Published in Cong bao No. 40 of 22 January 2026. Art. 33 repeals Chapter IV (AI) and related clauses of the Law on Digital Technology Industry. Transitional period (art. 35): AI systems already in operation must comply within 18 months (health, education, finance) or 12 months (others). Detailed by Decree 142/2026/ND-CP; implementation plan in Decision 367/QD-TTg.

instruments.english_title: Decree No. 142/2026/ND-CP detailing a number of articles of, and measures to implement, the Law on Artificial Intelligence
instruments.summary: Implementing decree of the AI Law (46 articles). It sets the AI one-stop portal and database, rules and tools for risk classification, the procedure for a list of high-risk AI systems, conformity assessment and notification of classification results, technical marking and visible labelling of AI-generated content, serious-incident reporting, and impact assessment when state agencies use AI systems (art. 20). It also regulates the controlled-testing (sandbox) mechanism, national AI infrastructure and data for AI, support vouchers, and assigns responsibilities to the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Public Security, other ministries and provincial People's Committees.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Main secondary legislation operationalising the AI Law's risk-based regime.
instruments.current_status: Issued 30 April 2026, in force from 1 May 2026 (art. 45); published in Cong bao No. 278 of 18 May 2026. Transitional rules (art. 46) allow notifications/reports through other systems until the Ministry of Science and Technology officially operates the AI one-stop portal. A draft of this decree was consulted by the Ministry of Science and Technology in February 2026.

instruments.english_title: Decision No. 1671/QD-TTg approving the National Strategy on Artificial Intelligence to 2030, with a vision to 2045
instruments.summary: Viet Nam's current national AI strategy, issued on the proposal of the Ministry of Science and Technology and based on the AI Law. It is organised in nine pillars: AI human resources and skills, data and AI models, AI infrastructure, R&D and mastery of AI technology, AI in national governance, AI for sectors, AI for SMEs and cooperatives, the AI ecosystem, and safe and trustworthy AI governance. The Ministry of Science and Technology leads, coordinates and monitors implementation (art. 2).
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Current national AI strategy, replacing the 2021 strategy.
instruments.current_status: Signed 28 August 2026 and effective on signature; published in Cong bao No. 507 of 12 September 2026. Art. 3 replaces Decision 127/QD-TTg of 26 January 2021.

instruments.english_title: Decision No. 127/QD-TTg promulgating the National Strategy on Research, Development and Application of Artificial Intelligence to 2030
instruments.summary: Viet Nam's first national AI strategy, issued on the proposal of the Ministry of Science and Technology. It aimed for Viet Nam to be among the top four ASEAN countries in AI research and application by 2030 and an AI innovation hub, with national big-data and high-performance computing centres and national AI innovation centres. It assigned tasks to ministries, led by the Ministry of Science and Technology, including building a legal framework for AI.
instruments.current_status: Issued and effective 26 January 2021 (signed Vu Duc Dam); published in Cong bao No. 147+148 of 2 February 2021. Replaced from 28 August 2026 by Decision 1671/QD-TTg (art. 3).

instruments.official_title: Luật Công nghiệp công nghệ số (Luật số 71/2025/QH15)
instruments.english_title: Law on Digital Technology Industry (Law No. 71/2025/QH15)
instruments.summary: Law governing the digital technology industry, including semiconductors and digital assets. Its Chapter IV (arts. 41-45) contained Viet Nam's first statutory AI rules: principles for developing, providing and deploying AI, the AI strategy, management of AI systems including high-risk ones, identification marks for AI systems and AI-generated products, and responsibilities of AI developers, providers and deployers.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: First statutory AI provisions; its AI chapter was repealed by the AI Law.
instruments.current_status: In force since 1 January 2026 (published in Cong bao No. 965+966 of 24 July 2025). Chapter IV on AI (and related definitions/clauses) was repealed by art. 33 of Law 134/2025/QH15 on AI with effect from 1 March 2026; the rest of the law remains in force.

instruments.official_title: Luật Bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân (Luật số 91/2025/QH15)
instruments.english_title: Law on Personal Data Protection (Law No. 91/2025/QH15)
instruments.summary: Viet Nam's first personal data protection law. Art. 30 governs personal data in big data, AI, blockchain, metaverse and cloud environments: processing must be limited to its purpose, systems must integrate security, authentication and access controls, processing of personal data by AI must be classified by risk level, and AI systems using personal data must not be used to harm national security or individuals' rights.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Statutory data-protection rules specific to AI processing of personal data.
instruments.current_status: Adopted 26 June 2025, in force 1 January 2026 (Cong bao No. 971+972). Detailed by Decree 356/2025/ND-CP.

instruments.english_title: Decree No. 356/2025/ND-CP detailing a number of articles of, and measures to implement, the Law on Personal Data Protection
instruments.summary: Implementing decree of the Personal Data Protection Law. Its art. 10 on personal data in AI systems and the metaverse allows personal data to be used to research and develop self-learning algorithms and AI systems subject to data-protection rules, treats AI inference outputs that can identify a person as personal data, and requires controllers to notify data subjects of automated processing, explain how the algorithm works and its effects on their rights, and offer an opt-out.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Automated-decision and AI-specific data protection rules.
instruments.current_status: Issued 31 December 2025, in force 1 January 2026 (Cong bao No. 18, 18 January 2026). It ends the validity of Decree 13/2023/ND-CP of 17 April 2023 on personal data protection.

instruments.official_title: Thông tư số 05/2026/TT-BKHCN ban hành Khung đạo đức trí tuệ nhân tạo quốc gia
instruments.english_title: Circular No. 05/2026/TT-BKHCN promulgating the National Artificial Intelligence Ethics Framework
instruments.summary: Circular issued under the AI Law setting the National AI Ethics Framework (art. 3): safety by design, reliability and quality testing, human oversight and intervention, resilience and security against data/model poisoning and adversarial attacks; respect for human rights, fairness and bias mitigation, transparency about AI use, explainability and accountability; and social benefit, inclusion and environmental sustainability. It applies to state bodies and to organisations and individuals developing, providing, deploying or using AI systems for state management or public services, and other actors in Viet Nam are encouraged to apply it.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: National AI ethics framework required by art. 26 of the AI Law; binding for public-sector AI.
instruments.current_status: Issued and in force 10 March 2026 (art. 4); published in Cong bao No. 159 of 25 March 2026. A Ministry of Science and Technology consultation item said the framework would update and replace Decision 1290/QD-BKHCN on responsible AI principles (not verified from the circular's text; see leads).

instruments.english_title: Decision No. 2422/QD-BGDDT promulgating the Framework of AI Education Content for General Education Students
instruments.summary: Ministry of Education and Training framework making AI education part of general schooling from the 2026-2027 school year after a 2025-2026 pilot, with a core part of 12 periods per class per year. Schools must vet AI tools for age-appropriateness and terms of use, supervise students' AI use, comply with personal data, IP and information-security rules, set up AI incident handling and reporting, and must not require students to use personal accounts or unvetted tools.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Sector rules for AI use and AI education in schools.

instruments.english_title: Decision No. 33/2026/QD-TTg promulgating the List of High-Risk Artificial Intelligence Systems
instruments.summary: Issues the list of high-risk AI systems annexed to the decision, implementing the risk classification of the Law on Artificial Intelligence and Decree 142/2026/ND-CP. A system is high-risk if it can cause significant harm to life, health, rights and legitimate interests, public or national interests or national security and is not excluded under Decree 142; the annex lists systems in education, ethnic and religious affairs, health, banking, judicial proceedings and transport. Providers and deployers of listed systems already operating must meet AI-law obligations by 1 September 2027 (health, education, finance) or 1 March 2027 (other sectors).
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Defines which AI systems are high-risk under the AI Law regime.
instruments.current_status: Signed 30 June 2026 by Deputy Prime Minister Ho Quoc Dung on behalf of the Prime Minister; in force from 15 August 2026 (art. 3); published in Cong bao No. 395 of 14 July 2026. Art. 4 sets transitional deadlines for systems already in operation (1 September 2027 for health, education and finance; 1 March 2027 for other sectors).

instruments.english_title: Decision No. 804/QD-TTg promulgating the List of Datasets Serving AI Development in Essential Fields
instruments.summary: Promulgates the list of datasets to be built, standardised, labelled and shared for AI development in essential fields over 2026-2030 (Annex I, e.g. Vietnamese and ethnic-minority language data, national knowledge data, legal-document data, science and technology data), plus a priority subset for early deployment (Annex II). Ministries, ministerial-level agencies and provincial People's Committees are assigned to build the datasets, the Ministry of Public Security coordinates and monitors, and data use must follow the laws on data, personal data protection, state secrets and intellectual property.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Implements the AI Law's provisions on data for AI by setting the national dataset programme.

instruments.english_title: Circular No. 53/2026/TT-NHNN on safety, risk management and deployment conditions for the application of AI systems in the banking sector
instruments.summary: Sets safety, risk-management and deployment conditions for AI systems that make or support decisions in banking services to customers, applying to credit institutions, foreign bank branches, payment intermediaries, mobile-money providers, credit information companies and other listed units. It requires risk classification by reference to the high-risk list in Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg, human control conditions, security, data, change and incident management, logging, impact assessment for high-risk systems, outsourcing and supply-chain risk, and staffing requirements.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: First sector-regulator rulebook implementing the AI Law's risk regime in finance.
instruments.current_status: Dated 30 September 2026 and published in Cong bao No. 555 of 17 October 2026. Not yet in force at the date of this check.

instruments.english_title: Circular No. 49/2026/TT-BGDDT on the application of technology in higher education and vocational education
instruments.summary: Sets principles and conditions for using digital technology and AI in teaching, assessment, research, administration and student services at universities, colleges and vocational institutions. AI must support and not replace lecturers, results must stay verifiable, and art. 10 treats using AI to cheat, and failing to disclose AI use when required, as academic-integrity violations, with institutions to adopt internal rules. It also covers AI competence development, data governance and institutional responsibilities.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Sector-wide rules on AI use and academic integrity in higher and vocational education.
instruments.current_status: Dated 30 June 2026; in force from 15 August 2026 (art. 22); published in Cong bao No. 421 of 20 July 2026. Replaces Circular 15/2018/TT-BGDDT and the higher-education part of Circular 30/2023/TT-BGDDT on online training.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Viet Nam's Official Gazette, the government legal-documents portal, Prime Minister decisions, ministries and regulators were searched. No qualifying document was found for procurement, readiness indices or international agreements. The education ministry site and the national legal database were unavailable, and the content of some decisions and official letters, published only as images or not found, still needs to be checked.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. moet.gov.vn TLS failure/503; vbpl.vn script-rendered; signed PDFs on vanban.chinhphu.vn are scans (reviewed records read from the Official Gazette text PDFs on congbao.chinhphu.vn). Decision 367/QĐ-TTg image-only (located only); Decision 2422/QĐ-BGDĐT from the government policy portal summary (located only). Decree 13/2023 noted in Decree 356/2025's status. Run restarted after a usage-limit interruption (nothing had been saved). Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Official Gazette (congbao.chinhphu.vn) and Government legal-documents portal (vanban.chinhphu.vn): AI Law 134/2025 (in force), Decree 142/2026, Law 71/2025 on Digital Technology Industry (AI chapter repealed), PDP Law 91/2025, Decree 356/2025 (replacing Decree 13/2023). vbpl.vn could not be read (script-rendered).; Government: Prime Minister decisions: AI strategies 127/2021 (superseded) and 1671/2026, AI Law implementation plan 367/2026, AI human-resources programme 1528/2026.; Ministries: Science and Technology (legal documents, drafts, ethics circular 05/2026, chatbot letter as lead); Education and Training (AI education framework 2422/2026, located only); Public Security (PDP role, no separate AI document found); Health, Justice, Finance, Labour/Home Affairs, Defence: searched, nothing AI-specific found.; Regulators: State Bank of Viet Nam: only research/news articles on AI, no AI-specific regulation or guidance found; personal data protection authority (Ministry of Public Security): no AI decision found; no separate competition/telecom AI documents found.. Not reached: moet.gov.vn (TLS failure / HTTP 503); vbpl.vn (script-rendered pages); full text of Decision 367/QD-TTg (image-only PDF). Could not verify: Decision 367/QD-TTg content (image-only PDF); Decision 1290/QD-BKHCN text and repeal; Official Letter 557/BKHCN-CDSQG text. procurement, index-readiness, international: no material found.
Wording note 2026-10-19 (narrative.review_notes): Two records could only be located because their official texts are image-only or the education ministry's site could not be reached. Weekly change check 2026-10-22: congbao.chinhphu.vn, chinhphu.vn and datafiles.chinhphu.vn load (with occasional connection resets, retried); moet.gov.vn and vanban.chinhphu.vn still reset connections. Added Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg, Decision 804/QD-TTg, Circular 53/2026/TT-NHNN and Circular 49/2026/TT-BGDDT, all missed by the 2026-10-12 review.
